name: Kendo-ComfyUI-H3 Fast v3 beta
readme:
## Open services

- **Page** — Port `3000`
- **Claude MCP** — Port `3001` (public RunPod HTTP proxy; access-code path, no IP allowlist)
- **Comfy** — Port `8188`
- **JupyterLab** — Port `8888`

Kendo MiniMax H3 Ref2VA Turbo studio v3 beta.16. The Page model dropdown includes the original MiniMax H3 INT8 checkpoint and Singularity V2 pruned INT8 (20 GB); Original remains the default. Both choices use the same SageAttention/Turbo Ref2VA workflow, 9 image / 1 video / 3 audio references, seed lock, queue status, generated-files page and bottom Comfy log. First launch downloads both diffusion checkpoints plus the shared encoder, VAEs and Turbo LoRA (about 65 GB total) with resume support to /workspace. Existing v1/v2 and Local releases remain unchanged.
